title: Concrete normalized Kummer target over a scheme
statement: Given the actual p-adic reduction D on a scheme W, an arbitrary integral source S, supported finite-coefficient source objects Q_n, an Ext-one boundary delta, its canonical source comparison a, and arbitrary source and finite-class predicates, define sheafKummerConclusion to be normalizedBoundaryTarget specialized to the actual scalar extension and forgetting functors, comparison units, actual roots tower, coefficient restrictions of Q_n and the finite line, and kummerRootNormalization. This is exactly the existing target proposition [def-sfb-diagonal-system-interface] with its actual arguments; no object is chosen and no property is added or removed.

def sheafKummerConclusion (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (W : Scheme.{u})
    (hW : IsUnit (ℓ : Γ(W, ⊤)))
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (DiagonalAb W)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (DiagonalSystems ℓ W)]
    [HasExt.{u + 1} (DiagonalSystems ℓ W)]
    (D : DiagonalDerivedReduction ℓ (diagonalScalarExtension ℓ W))
    (S : DiagonalAb W)
    (Q : ∀ n, Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology W)
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (diagonalResidue.{u} ℓ n)))
    (δ : Ext.{u + 1} S ((comparisonUpperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} W).obj W.gmSheaf) 1)
    (sourceNorm : sheafKummerSourcePredicate ℓ W D S Q)
    (finiteClass : sheafKummerFinitePredicate ℓ W Q)
    (a : D.T.obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj S) ≅
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (D.ordinary.E.obj S))
    : Prop
